instruction: The file `/home/user/Desktop/messy.sch` is the schematic to process. Renumber the capacitor refdes so they increase in top-to-bottom, left-to-right geometric order, and save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/renumbered.sch`. Requirements: 1. The file must be valid XML. 2. The number of `C`-prefixed parts must be preserved. 3. Every capacitor `<part>` must have a matching `<instance>`. 4. When capacitor instances are sorted by `(-y, x)`, their refdes numbers must strictly increase. 5. The top-left-most capacitor must be `C1`. 6. No `<pinref>` may reference a non-existent part. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
